raw:
“Finding my wedding ring in the garden—that was a happy moment. I remember a glint beneath the garden bench, and then realizing it was my ring. A little bit of light, but it caught my attention. I work as a cashier at a lighting store, so it’s funny that light is part of what I remember about it.

The wedding date is engraved inside the band. Looking at that made it feel especially lovely to have it back. It wasn’t just finding something valuable; it was my wedding ring, with that date inside. My attention went from that tiny glint to the ring, and then to what it meant to me. I was so pleased I’d noticed it.”
